london.note: London: narrative vs reality. The rising line is an illustrative index of the social-media 'London is unsafe / in decline' narrative — not scraped analytics. Its one measured anchor is City Hall's finding that stories on social media calling London dangerous or in decline rose about 200% in the two years to 2025; earlier years are an illustrative baseline, and the dated posts below are what pin the shape. The falling line and the metric cards are real published figures from the Metropolitan Police, City Hall and the ONS, each carrying its source. Homicide is the headline reality metric (the figure Mayor Khan led with on LBC): 97 in 2025, the fewest since 2014, and a lower rate per head than Paris, Berlin or New York. Two metrics are shown honestly against the trend — knife crime rose to a record in 2024/25 before a recent turn, and recorded sexual offences remain high, a post-pandemic rise that partly reflects more victims coming forward.

narrative.note: Illustrative baseline — 'London decline' a fringe online theme.

metrics.label: Residential burglary
metrics.latest: Down 10% year on year; down ~28% since 2016

metrics.label: Knife crime
metrics.latest: Rose to a record ~16,344 offences in 2024/25, then fell ~7% (1,154 fewer) in the 12 months to Aug 2025

metrics.label: Sexual offences
metrics.latest: ≈25,000 recorded in 2023/24 and holding — a post-pandemic rise that partly reflects more victims reporting, not a fall
